question: Under W2(r, beta) (738 kinds in [0,3] x [-3,3], weights exp(-beta D), beta = 0, 1, 2, r = 3..5), what share of travelling bases with a new kind have two certified unlengthened shifts?
forbidden_inputs: Changing weightings, seeds, stopping rule, arms or criteria after seeing results
primary_observable: Per weighting and stratum: travelling rate; certified two-direction share; forced-uncertified; none found
cheapest_meaningful_control: Old-box stratum under beta = 0 (replicates W(r)); calibration on the old census

predictions.W1: pass (Wilson lower >= 50%, point >= 70%) under all three weightings on the new-kinds stratum
predictions.W2: old-box share within the old interval
predictions.W3: enlarged arm adds <= 5 of 23 on the old census

decision_rules.fail: Wilson upper < 70% under some weighting: the rule does not hold beyond one box
decision_rules.inconclusive: otherwise, or fewer than 40 travelling new-kind bases

stop_rule: One run; hand-off to the referee thread.
runtime: Hours; per-sample saves; 3,600 s cap; registered.
